request: Analyze GSE273694 for PMID 39746949 (Pantothenate kinase 4 controls skeletal muscle substrate metabolism.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.sample_inclusion: male PanK4 WT and PanK4 mKO mice, 28 weeks old, glucose-injected 40 min before euthanasia (S4.1.1.4.p1); no exercise arm in the RNA-seq experiment
final.primary_estimand: Genotype effect (PanK4 mKO vs WT) on gastrocnemius gene expression under glucose injection, used to check BCAA-catabolism genes (S2.6.p5, Fig. S9A-C). The paper's exercise data (Fig. 1A-C, Fig. 4E-H, Fig. S7) are phosphoproteomics, Western blots and glucose uptake, not transcriptomics.
planned_contrasts: PanK4 mKO vs PanK4 WT (S2.6.p5; paper reports no DEG count, only 'no significant alterations in genes encoding enzymes related to BCAA catabolism')
final.normalization: StringTie FPKM (S4.1.1.4.p1); GEO deposits prepDE.py read counts
final.paper_results: No DEG count stated; BCAA catabolism genes not significantly altered (S2.6.p5, Fig. S9A-C, supplementary data 2)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S11.p1 deposits the whole-genome RNA-seq as GSE273694. S4.1.1.4.p1 defines the experiment: gastrocnemius from male PanK4 WT and mKO mice injected with glucose 40 min before euthanasia, DESeq2. Exercise appears in the paper only as human phosphoproteomics/Western (S2.1.p1-p2, S4.1.1.1-2) and mouse treadmill glucose uptake/metabolites (S2.6.p4); none of it was sequenced.

checks: GEO: gastrocnemius, male, C57BL/6J, PanK4 WT/mKO, 4-h fast then glucose injection, STAR + StringTie prepDE.py, GRCm39.110 - all match S4.1.1.4.p1
14 samples (8 WT, 6 mKO); Fig. 1E uses n = 8 WT from this transcriptome

ownership.reasoning: Accession, tissue, genotype, glucose-injection protocol, aligner and assembly all match the paper's methods.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns M1-M14 equal the metadata description field exactly (inspect alignment_keys: 14/14). Genotype and treatment aliased to formula-safe names.

matrix.reasoning: All values are integers (integer_fraction 1.0, max 1.77e6); GEO data_processing says 'Read count extraction via STRINGTIE v2.2.1 and prepDE.py ... raw counts'. prepDE.py derives read counts from coverage, so these are count-scale. The paper mentions FPKM for abundance but ran DESeq2, which needs counts, consistent with this file.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast exists in GSE273694. Every sample is resting gastrocnemius after a 4-h fast and glucose injection (treatment constant across all 14 samples); the only factor is PanK4 genotype (8 WT vs 6 mKO). The paper's exercise experiments (human p-PanK4 Ser63, mouse treadmill glucose uptake) were not sequenced. A genotype contrast is not an exercise effect, so the requested estimand cannot be identified from these data.

candidates.value: genotype mKO vs WT (paper's DESeq2 contrast)
candidates.reason_rejected: valid genotype comparison but it answers a knockout question, not how exercise affects gene expression; not run as a substitute for the requested estimand
